title: reader drain: missing comment explaining semaphore-as-quiescence-barrier
description: In crates/reader/src/main.rs, the shutdown drain block (lines 315-353) uses acquire_many(max_connections as u32) on semaphore_drain to detect that all sessions have finished. This is a non-obvious tokio::Semaphore pattern: acquiring all permits is only possible when no session holds a permit, so a successful acquire means zero active connections. There is no comment explaining: (1) why semaphore_drain is cloned before the select! rather than using semaphore directly, (2) why acquiring all max_connections permits signals quiescence. A reader cold to this code must infer the relationship between accept_loop (which holds one permit per live session) and the drain (which attempts to acquire all permits). Add a short comment at the semaphore_drain clone and at the acquire_many call explaining the pattern.
